categories.name: build
categories.evidence: Modifies GitHub Actions workflow configurations, action files, and CI runner scripts across Linux, macOS, and Windows.
categories.rationale: Mitigates intermittent CI job failures caused by HTTP 504 gateway timeouts when repeatedly downloading shared test assets. As noted in issue #36814, repeated requests across parallel jobs can fail before tests begin, though the issue has a low occurrence rate in practice.

categories.name: tests
categories.evidence: Labeled Tests and updates test asset management in test/download_utils.py for unit test vectors and fuzz corpora.
categories.rationale: Improves test infrastructure reliability by adding manifest verification and centralized asset handling for test corpora and vectors. It addresses test runner failures caused by external asset fetching timeouts, although the failure frequency is relatively low.
